About the Gubernatorial Candidate

A Leader Who Walks
Among the People

Hon. Murango is not your typical politician. He's a farmer who understands the soil, a community organiser who listens before acting, and a legislator who delivers results. With nearly a decade in the National Assembly, he has consistently championed the interests of Kirinyaga's ordinary citizens.

From subsidising fertiliser for smallholder farmers to pushing for better schools and health facilities, Murango's record speaks for itself. His hands-on approach—visiting farms, attending community barazas—sets him apart.

  • ✓
    Champion of small-scale farmers in Kirinyaga
  • ✓
    Advocate for quality, accessible education
  • ✓
    County-wide development across all wards
  • ✓
    Transparent, accountable governance
Policy Manifesto

Our Vision for Kirinyaga County 2027

🌾
Agriculture & Food Security
  • Subsidised fertiliser for all small-scale farmers
  • Modern irrigation infrastructure
  • Fair market prices for tea & coffee
  • Youth agri-enterprise grants
🎓
Education & Youth
  • 100 new bursaries per year
  • Digital learning labs in every ward
  • Vocational training centres
  • Youth innovation fund
🏥
Healthcare Access
  • Equip all dispensaries with modern tools
  • Free maternal & child health services
  • Mobile health clinics for remote areas
  • Mental health awareness programs
🛣️
Infrastructure & Trade
  • Tarmac key feeder roads
  • Expand clean water coverage to 90%
  • Improve market infrastructure
  • Fibre internet in trading centres
